provenance: Proposed by Codex in this conversation, before evaluating this candidate batch. These are model-authored hypotheses, not autonomous API calls.

candidates.name: avoid_tiny_gaps
candidates.hypothesis: Preserve room for later items by avoiding nonzero leftovers smaller than 10.

candidates.name: avoid_subitem_gaps
candidates.hypothesis: A leftover smaller than the current item may be difficult to reuse; sacrifice immediate tightness to avoid it.

candidates.name: tight_or_roomy
candidates.hypothesis: Take exact and near-exact fits, otherwise leave a roomy gap that can accept future items.

candidates.name: reserve_quarter
candidates.hypothesis: A residual near 25 may be more reusable than arbitrary narrow gaps on small-item mixtures.

candidates.name: reserve_half
candidates.hypothesis: A residual near 50 may accommodate diverse future items, while exact fits should still dominate.

candidates.name: avoid_subthird
candidates.hypothesis: Avoid leftovers below one third of capacity unless the fit is exact.
